value.rationale: Viot and Krapivsky solved the one-site trimer frequencies but expressly left pair correlations as an interesting extension. The physically meaningful rare triple-coverage layer has an unexpectedly nonmonotone positive/negative/positive spatial covariance profile, a sharp six-site dependence radius, a natural macroscopic count with a nondegenerate exact CLT variance and an exact finite-size correction. Those facts are not obtained from the one-site table or a generic CLT alone.
